# Card / set coverage

<!-- Generated by packages/sets/scripts/audit-sets.js. Do not edit by hand. -->
<!-- Regenerate: npm run compile -w packages/sets && npm run audit:sets -w packages/sets -->

Static audit of every card exported by `@ptcg/sets`. Each card is classified by
whether the parts of its printed text that need game logic are referenced by
its `reduceEffect`. This is a heuristic, not a rules check: "implemented" means
the code *dispatches on* the attack/power, not that the effect is correct.

## Totals

| Cards | Implemented | Vanilla | Complete | Partial | Needs logic | With spec |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 861 | 802 | 59 | 861 (100%) | 0 | 0 | 584 (67.8%) |

- **Implemented** — needs logic, and every attack/power that needs logic is
  referenced from the class (`attacks[i]` / `powers[i]`); Trainers and Special
  Energy count when they override `reduceEffect`.
- **Vanilla** — nothing on the card needs code: attacks with plain numeric
  damage and no text, no powers, basic Energy, or Special Energy whose text only
  restates `provides`. Counted as complete.
- **Partial** — overrides `reduceEffect` but never references at least one
  attack/power that has text, or the source carries a TODO/FIXME marker.
- **Needs logic** — has text that needs code but no `reduceEffect` override.
- **With spec** — a `tests/<group>/<set>/<card-file>.spec.ts` exists.

## Per set

Official sizes are listed only where certain. "Standard" folders are curated
collections drawn from many printed sets (card set codes shown), so they have no
official size. "Present" counts entries in the exported set array; alternate
prints of the same name (e.g. `Charmander RG-2`) count separately. The percentage
is measured against the number of *distinct* cards: Jungle, Fossil and Team Rocket
print every holo rare a second time as a non-holo with identical text, and those
reprints are implemented once.

None flagged.

## Text/code keyword mismatches (advisory)

The card text mentions a mechanic but the class source contains none of the
code that mechanic normally needs (`CoinFlipPrompt`, a shuffle, `SpecialCondition`,
or a shared `common*` helper). Some are legitimate (the condition is only
*referenced*, not inflicted); review by hand. Status above is unaffected.

| Set | Card | Text mentions | Review note | File |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| set-base | Devolution Spray BS | special condition | False positive: conditions are cleared by `pokemonSlot.clearEffects()`. | `packages/sets/src/base-sets/set-base/devolution-spray.ts` |
| set-black-and-white-2 | Virbank City Gym PLS | special condition | False positive: Poisoned is only referenced (`poisonDamage += 20`). | `packages/sets/src/standard/set-black-and-white-2/virbank-city-gym.ts` |

## Method and limits

- Cards are read from the compiled `packages/sets/dist/cjs` export; class names are
  mapped back to source files through each set's `index.ts` imports.
- Cards in this repo dispatch with `effect.attack === this.attacks[i]` and
  `this.powers[i]`; the audit checks for those references textually. A card
  that referenced an attack some other way (by name, via a loop) would be
  reported as partial. A `this.attacks[i]` / `this.powers[i]` reference past the
  end of the list is reported as a dangling reference.
- Passive powers that cannot be blocked (e.g. Ancient Traits) are sometimes
  implemented without touching `powers[i]`; a code comment naming the power
  (`// Delta Plus`) is accepted as a reference for powers only.
- An attack needs logic when its text is non-empty or its damage is not a plain
  number (`30+`, `10×`). Text that only matters in double battles ("Ignore this
  effect if your opponent has only 1 Defending Pokémon") needs none. Every power
  needs logic. Every Trainer with text needs logic; an override is the only
  signal checked for Trainers and Special Energy. Special Energy whose text only
  restates `provides` (Double Colorless Energy) is vanilla.
- Card text is taken from the class itself. A card whose printed text was left
  out of the class would look vanilla; the audit cannot detect that without an
  external card database.
- Missing cards in a set are counted against the distinct-card count but not named,
  for the same reason.
- Engine-level rules (Pokémon-ex prize count, Stadium/Supporter play limits) are
  not card text and are not audited.
- "Implemented" does not mean correct; only cards with a spec have behavioural
  evidence. TODO markers are searched outside string literals.
